notes.title: Development update version 0.1.8 released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone🥷🏽🥷🏽🥷🏽

Good news for players who want to share their cool play videos and want to know how  your avatars are do something. We are pleased to announce the release of a new update with a new recording feature.

[ADDED]
・A new feature has been added to the game: the ability to record a virtual camera (3rd-person viewpoint) video of the game being played. When the in-game menu is opened, a button to start recording appears in the upper right corner of the menu. Recorded videos can be played back in VR. Recorded videos are saved in My Documents on your PC. The video is recorded in MP4 format and FHD size.

[FIXED]
・Fixed a problem in which the license data of VRM, which is automatically loaded at startup, was not displayed.

That's all for this update.
Stay tuned for the next update!
Our development team is always open to your feedback!

See you next time🥰⭐

notes.title: Release information Version 0.1.7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone🌀⭐

We are pleased to announce the release of version 0.1.7, a minor update that includes a fix for the shuriken behavior that has been requested for improvement since last time🥷🏽
Also, you can now select your avatar and enemy models from within your VR goggles, whereas you could only do so from your Desktop PC.


Version 0.1.7 update details.

･Fixed an issue with shuriken throwing causing them to fly in an unintended direction. This is supported for all Vive, Metaquest, and Pico series controllers in the in-game controller device list.
･The file selection method for VRM avatars and enemy models can now be pulled down from within VR goggles. You can freely select the VRM or GLB file of the avatar of your choice by putting it in the folder in “My Documents” that is automatically generated. You can also continue to operate from the desktop.
･The menu screen can now be freely repositioned. You can move the menu screen to any position by placing the pointer on the handlebar below the menu screen and holding down the trigger.
･The position of the external camera can be freely changed. The camera can be grabbed and moved to any position by placing the pointer on the handlebar at the bottom of the menu screen and pressing and holding the trigger.
･Preview screen has been placed next to the external camera model. You can now see how you look from the external camera.



That's all for this updateːsteamthumbsupː
Please stay tuned for the next update!
Our development team is always open to your feedback!

See you next time!!

notes.title: Release information Version 0.1.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are releasing version 0.1.6 in response to your valuable feedback🥷🏽
We are mainly removing and adjusting the user interface that could be misleading to players. This will make the experience more seamless.

Because the shuriken trajectory is sometimes more difficult than expected, this is not included in this release, but we are currently working on a development fix (this is true😟😭 please wait a little longer🧕🏽!) Please note that the settings of your VR device are not included in this release. It includes an update to allow you to properly select the settings for your VR device.

We have also included instructions on how to install VRM and GLB files, which are part of the feature, in the Steam guide. This is a guide because it was almost impossible to figure out how to set them up.(here) 


Hello everyone!

We are releasing version 0.1.6 in response to your valuable feedback🥷🏽
We are mainly removing and adjusting the user interface that could be misleading to players. This will make the experience more seamless.

Because the shuriken trajectory is sometimes more difficult than expected, this is not included in this release, but we are currently working on a development fix (it's really 😟😭 please wait a little longer🧕🏽!) Please note that the settings of your VR device are not included in this release. It includes an update to allow you to properly select the settings for your VR device.

We have also included instructions on how to install VRM and GLB files, which are part of the feature, in the Steam guide. This is a guide because it was almost impossible to figure out how to set them up.


Version 0.1.6 Update Contents.
･Removed the scroll ranks for Genin(low rank ninja), Chunin(middle rank ninja), and Jonin(expart ninja).
･Removed the “Under Construction” indicator for Basic Training and Oni Training.
･The number of points required to pass the warming up training has been lowered.
･The difficulty level of shuriken training in warming up Training has been made easier.
･The hit counts panel required to defeat enemies in shuriken training have been added to the basic training and oni training.
･Added additional text for grayed out settings in the options screen.
･If the setup of the VR device to be used has not been completed, can no longer proceed.
･Other unnecessary UI has been removed.


Known Issues.
Player's shuriken throwing does not work properly.

That's all for this update.
Please stay tuned for the next update!
Our development team is always open to your feedback!

See you next time!
